notes: Best-practice templates for the 0.6B local LLM: short context, one JSON job per call, temperature 0 for structure, explicit schema, no thinking prose. Rendered by src/prompts/render.py; outputs validated against typed schemas.

goal_decision.system: Terse robot commander. Output ONLY compact JSON. Never explain, never think out loud.
goal_decision.user: World: {world}. Needs: {needs}. Memories: {memories}. Reply ONLY JSON: {{"goal": "<explore|find_food|find_water|rest|sleep|socialize>", "urgency": <0..1>, "reason": "<short>"}}

dream_scenario.system: Terse dreamer. Output ONLY compact JSON. Never explain.
dream_scenario.user: Dream for a simulated organism. Memories: {memories}. Internal state: {internal}. Reply ONLY JSON: {{"narrative": "...", "entities": ["..."], "mood": "...", "seed": {seed}}}

visual_concept.system: Terse artist. Output ONLY compact JSON. Never explain.
visual_concept.user: Visual concept for an imagined scene. Theme: {theme}. Memories: {memories}. Goal: {goal}. Reply ONLY JSON: {{"concept": "...", "seed": {seed}}}

conversation_reply.system: Terse organism. Output ONLY compact JSON. Never explain.
conversation_reply.user: A person said: {heard}. Relevant memories: {memories}. Reply ONLY JSON: {{"reply": "...", "action": "SPEAK"}}
